name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
purpose: Provide all-weather rural road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations.
eligible_works: Construction and major upgradation of all-weather rural roads, culverts, cross-drainage structures, blacktopping, village approach roads.
exclusions: Internal village lanes/paving (covered by panchayat funds), national/state highways, urban municipal roads.
disclaimer: Summary for prototype, verify with official MoRD guidelines

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)
purpose: Provide Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household with safe and adequate drinking water.
eligible_works: Piped drinking water distribution networks, borewell solar pumps, village water storage tanks, filtration plants, community tap points.
exclusions: Agricultural irrigation pipelines, private household plumbing repairs, sewage treatment lines.
disclaimer: Summary for prototype, verify with official Jal Shakti guidelines

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
purpose: Enhance livelihood security by providing 100 days of guaranteed wage employment while creating durable rural community assets.
eligible_works: Water conservation and harvesting, check dams, desilting of ponds/canals, rural connectivity gravel paths, flood control bunds, farm ponds.
exclusions: Heavy machine-only contractor works, high-tech industrial construction, works on private land without small/marginal farmer status.
disclaimer: Summary for prototype, verify with official MoRD guidelines

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
purpose: Provide financial assistance to homeless and kutcha/dilapidated house owners in rural areas to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
eligible_works: Rural pucca housing clusters, disaster-resilient dwelling units, housing sanitation attachment, solar electrification for dwelling clusters.
exclusions: Urban multi-storey housing, commercial retail shops, non-residential community buildings.
disclaimer: Summary for prototype, verify with official MoRD guidelines

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
purpose: Provide inclusive and equitable quality education from pre-school to senior secondary level with modern infrastructure.
eligible_works: Government school classroom additions, school boundary walls, girl-child toilet blocks, drinking water points, science/computer labs.
exclusions: Private/unaided school premises, teacher salary deficits, higher education/university infrastructure.
disclaimer: Summary for prototype, verify with official MoE guidelines

name: National Health Mission (NHM / Ayushman Arogya Mandir)
purpose: Universal access to equitable, affordable, and quality public health care services in rural and tribal regions.
eligible_works: Primary Health Centre (PHC) building upgradation, Sub-Health Centre solar power and labour rooms, community cold chain for vaccines, staff quarters.
exclusions: Tertiary super-specialty hospitals (AIIMS level), private nursing home grants, routine cosmetic renovations.
disclaimer: Summary for prototype, verify with official MoHFW guidelines
